Hong Kong Conglomerate Seeks $637 Million Bank Loan

Chow Tai Fook Enterprises Ltd., an investment arm of Hong Kong's billionaire Cheng family, is seeking approximately HK$5 billion ($637 million) in new funding from banks. This information comes from sources familiar with the matter.
